# apple_device (Resource)

Registers a device for development and ad hoc distribution.

App Store Connect cannot delete devices, so destroying this resource disables the device. A disabled device still counts toward the 100 devices of its class a team can register each membership year, until the list is reset at renewal. Disabling a device invalidates the provisioning profiles that contain it. Creating a device whose UDID is already registered, for example after destroying it, adopts and re-enables the existing device. Import it by its App Store Connect ID or UDID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_device" "test_phone" {
  name     = "QA iPhone"
  udid     = "00008030-001A2B3C4D5E6F70"
  platform = "IOS"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the device.
- `platform` (String) Platform: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `UNIVERSAL`. Changing it creates a new resource.
- `udid` (String) UDID of the device. Changing it registers a new device.

### Optional

- `status` (String) Status of the device: `ENABLED`, `DISABLED`. Defaults to `ENABLED`.

### Read-Only

- `added_date` (String) When the device was registered, in RFC 3339 format.
- `device_class` (String) Class of the device, e.g. `IPHONE`.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the device.
- `model` (String) Model of the device.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_device.test_phone
  identity = {
    id = "8Q6Z4X2RJ7"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the device.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By App Store Connect ID or by UDID.
terraform import apple_device.test_phone 8Q6Z4X2RJ7
terraform import apple_device.test_phone 00008030-001A2B3C4D5E6F70
```
